title: ASD-STE100 writing rules: sentence length, voice, structure
description: As a technical writer, I want sentence-length limits (20 words for procedures, 25 for descriptions), one instruction per sentence, active voice, imperative procedures, no -ing forms (except -ing technical nouns), and article rules enforced, so that prose meets the STE writing rules. Spec first: Gherkin per rule group before heuristics.
